title: Specify and test an 18-place BIT transfer above the first higher grid point
body:
For the 15-decimal target K=0.003879928046156, derives an 18-place selector and a concrete seven-stage numerical example with raw trial 0.0038799280461560083 and explicit uniform/cover loss tests. The independent 54+4 outer arithmetic checks pass for the assumed valid BIT service. The adaptive probe binds an actual word receipt, reprices its changed signed and tail terms, and distinguishes an arithmetic rate plan from supplier qualification.

Pins #7863 b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781 and the alternative streamed stock work #7868 3f7c3c1f2a9a0963736562037e01fe41aec46b8c. Complements #7888's higher target. The relocated standard-library replay passed the zero-net, synthetic near-positive and 1e−60 rate controls and rejected changed source/receipt/word bytes. Credit original contributors. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

Supply a genuinely positive literal BIT word, establish its moment separation, stock, physical interfaces and rebind the full outer application.
